values.question: How does the Postgres checkpointer work?

docs.title: Postgres checkpointer
docs.body: LangGraph persistence uses PostgresSaver from langgraph-checkpoint-postgres. Every graph step is checkpointed in Postgres tables created by the migrate script, so a run can be inspected, resumed, or replayed after the fact. The same Postgres service also hosts the documents and notes tables.

docs.title: LangGraph starter overview
docs.body: This template deploys a production-wired LangGraph starter: FastAPI serves the API, LangGraph runs the demo graph, Postgres 18 stores both the LangGraph checkpointer state and the application tables, and pgvector holds document embeddings for retrieval. The demo graph retrieves documents, drafts an answer, and stops for a human decision before anything is published.

docs.title: Human-in-the-loop interrupts
docs.body: The review node calls LangGraph interrupt() with the draft and the retrieved documents, then pauses. Nothing is saved until the API resumes the run with an approve or reject decision. The thread state lives in the Postgres checkpointer, so the pause survives a server restart. Resume with POST /api/runs/{thread_id}/resume and an approved true/false body.

docs.title: Railway deployment
docs.body: Deploy with the Railway template: add a Postgres service and reference it as DATABASE_URL, set the pre-deploy command to python scripts/migrate.py so migrations run before each deploy, and healthcheck GET /api/health. The app binds $PORT. Optional integrations are env-gated: set OPENAI_API_KEY for LLM drafting and embeddings, and LANGSMITH_API_KEY with LANGSMITH_TRACING=true for LangSmith tracing. Without them the app reports not_configured and keeps working.

docs.title: pgvector retrieval
docs.body: Documents carry a 1536-dimension embedding column for text-embedding-3-small. When embeddings exist and an OpenAI key is set, retrieval is cosine similarity over pgvector; otherwise it is PostgreSQL full-text search over title and body. The retrieval method used is recorded in the run state and returned by the API.
